explanation: No evidence policy, validator or runbook changes. From this branch: ledger entries for 16 datasets and six additional comparison specs were added through the documented review route, recorded in turbo-2026-11-15/README.md; evidence folders await the next data release. compare_author_results.mts now appends its R 4.4.1 review sentence to a regenerated output only when the spec was not pinned to the current regenerated bytes; every earlier spec pins a predecessor, so existing generated notes are unchanged. From main: audit_author_validation.mts reads its default-track bundle with the strict bundle reader, and the query index output is byte-identical. Later from main: No evidence ledger, audit or fingerprinted producer changed: build_hfd_bundles_r460.mts and build_oxt_avp_bundles_r460.mts keep their bytes, and neither intake audit pins bundleWriter.mts or the September 5 builder. Audits pin track and pathway bundles, which are byte-identical; only qc_global.js nSig changes for rat_son_salt_gse65663, mouse_scn_hfd_gse157077 and mouse_pomc_maternal_hfd_gse135639, which no audit pins.
